🎥🎬: The Blacklist (2013–2023)

Raymond “Red” Reddington, one of the FBI’s most wanted criminals, suddenly turns himself in after decades of evading capture. But instead of going to prison, he offers the FBI a deal: he will help them track down the world’s most dangerous criminals—people the government doesn’t even know exist.

Red insists that he will only work with Elizabeth Keen, a rookie FBI profiler with whom he seems to share a mysterious connection. Together, they pursue criminals from Red’s secret “blacklist” while Red continues manipulating events from the shadows.

As the cases unfold, Liz begins questioning why Red chose her and what he knows about her past. Their complicated relationship becomes central to the series as secrets about family, identity, betrayal, and Red’s true motives gradually emerge.

source_details.synopsis: The Blacklist is an American crime thriller television series created by Jon Bokenkamp and developed by John Eisendrath. It stars James Spader as Raymond Reddington, an international criminal and one of the FBI's Most Wanted fugitives who cooperates with the FBI in hunting down other criminals on his "Blacklist". The series also stars Megan Boone, Diego Klattenhoff, Ryan Eggold, Amir Arison, Hisham Tawfiq, and Harry Lennix. The Blacklist was given a series order in May 2013, and ran for ten seasons from September 23, 2013, to July 13, 2023, on NBC. The pilot episode garnered 12.6 million viewers in the United States.
